metadata.title: That 1 lucky shot where Valorant said ‘Here’s a kill, don’t ask why’
metadata.description:
Wait, I barely clicked!
Enemy must be on a break or just confused.
Click if your best kill was a total accident.
Valorant logic at peak nonsense.

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but the kills still come!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
